description: Aider-polyglot style (TypeScript): topological build order from a dependency map with a smallest-ready-module tiebreak at every step (not a depth-first walk), implicit leaf modules, and an exact cycle error message that starts at the alphabetically smallest module on any cycle and reports the shortest, then lexicographically smallest, cycle. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs them, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
